replication.target_description: Schaffer and Knobe Replication, post-replication form Draft v0.2: Amazon Mechanical Turk participants, thief/person versus jewel/object rather-than contrast; main knowledge-ascription agreement outcome, between-condition t-test.

n.sample_role: Participants in two mutually exclusive randomized target conditions: 74 thief/person and 76 jewel/object.
n.exclusions: Results list 74 and 76 for the target groups. Methods report 150 recruited and 13 failed to complete; source does not reconcile this with the target-group counts. No further analytic exclusions specified.

The mean rating in the first case (thief/person contrast condition) was 6.21 (N=74 and SD=1.037).
The mean rating in the second case (jewel/object contrast condition) was 5.34 (N=76 and SD=1.837).

notes:
Original reference year in supplied citation is 2010; retrieved article is the 2012 Noûs version with matching title, authors, and DOI. Requested original test statistic is retained as printed. Replication effect size and p refer to the same main target comparison. Replication sample accounting is internally inconsistent: condition-specific Results Ns are retained as printed with low confidence; the recruited total is not substituted for an established post-exclusion analytic total. Supplied replication p. 2 locator is qualified because DOCX extraction does not independently preserve page boundaries. No further t statistic is printed for the replication.
Completion source review (n_r): Results explicitly report participant Ns in both mutually exclusive randomized target conditions. Sum follows target group counts; conflicting methods attrition statement is retained, not used to subtract participants.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors answer affirmatively to the success-assessment question asking whether they replicated the original result and whether the original team agrees.
